# Capsule

> Capsule is a local-first Codex plugin and MCP server for token reduction through exact-recoverable evidence compression.

## Canonical resources

- Repository: https://github.com/hakiyaka/capsule
- Project site: https://hakiyaka.github.io/capsule/
- Installation: https://hakiyaka.github.io/capsule/guide/install-capsule.html
- FAQ: https://hakiyaka.github.io/capsule/guide/faq.html
- Benchmarks: https://hakiyaka.github.io/capsule/guide/benchmarks-and-methodology.html
- Web search guide: https://hakiyaka.github.io/capsule/guide/web-search-token-savings.html
- Terminal guide: https://hakiyaka.github.io/capsule/guide/terminal-output-token-savings.html
- Methodology source: https://github.com/hakiyaka/capsule/blob/main/BENCHMARK.md
- Releases: https://github.com/hakiyaka/capsule/releases

## Scope

Capsule compacts repetitive terminal, file, project, web, memory, and context output while preserving local exact recovery. It passes through failures, unsafe or ambiguous requests, explicit full-output requests, and token-negative candidates.

## Measurement caveat

Published percentages are workload-specific model-visible observations. They do not claim control over hidden provider reasoning, provider caching, billing, or subscription quotas.
